*.forwards: address hand-off on every handle class

SoundIo.forwards: struct SoundIo's public fields as properties, read from and written to the native struct on each access; app_name's string held while libsoundio points into it

SoundIoDevice.forwards: struct SoundIoDevice's public fields as readonly properties, read from the native struct on each access

SoundIoOutStream.forwards: struct SoundIoOutStream's public fields as properties, read from and written to the native struct on each access; name and layout.name held while libsoundio points into them

SoundIoInStream.forwards: struct SoundIoInStream's public fields as properties, read from and written to the native struct on each access; name and layout.name held while libsoundio points into them

SoundIoRingBufferBridge.forwards: addresses of native write_callback / read_callback functions that move frames between a stream and the SoundIoRingBuffer at its userdata, filling silence when the ring runs dry; libsoundio calls them on its audio thread, where PHP cannot run
